department: Department of Biological Sciences (Biology Graduate Program)

deadline.value: Fall deadline is January 15 for US and international applicants; later applications may have limited funding.
deadline.quote: Fall: January 15 for U.S. and International applicants

supervisor.value: You must identify a faculty adviser; applicants without one are not admitted.
supervisor.quote: a graduate student will not be admitted to the Biology Program for graduate studies unless the prospective student has identified a faculty adviser

funding.value: The program does not accept PhD students without support.
funding.quote: the Biology Graduate Program does not accept M.S. and Ph.D. students without support

entry_route.value: Successful applicants usually have a bachelor's in biological sciences or a related field.
entry_route.quote: Successful applicants usually have a Bachelor’s degree in Biological Sciences or a related field

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.
